name: stuck-order-import-tool
description: Windows PowerShell GUI tool for finding and batch-copying stuck/missing order KC XML files by order number.
summary: This tool helps staff quickly find and copy order XML files that are stuck or missing by entering order numbers. It provides a simple interface to search a folder of order files, shows which orders were found or not, and safely copies the matched files to a chosen location. It is designed for operations teams who need to manage and resolve order import issues efficiently.
